The team has successfully collected data at the three streams (Bear Creek, Mill Branch, and Creech Hollow)! Now that we have learned how to put our data in a nice and tidy format, let’s learn a bit about our dataset! The tidy dataset and all required R packages are being loaded into the background. When complete, you can call the entire dataset using stream_data in the code blocks below. The stream_data has also been further split into a dataset called nitrogen and a dataset called conductivity that can also be used in the R code blocks.
